title: UFCPS Structural Deadlock Object and Procedural Continuity State
description: Machine-readable state contract for UFCPS. Defines the structure required to preserve a continuous cognitive process across changing carriers.
$comment: This schema validates structural representation only. It does not prove mathematical correctness, task solvability, semantic truth, or convergence. Such properties require external mathematical or runtime validation.

step_index.description: Non-negative sequential index of the current procedural unit.

carrier_type.description: Technology or architecture profile of the current computational carrier.

session_status.description: Execution phase of the current local carrier.

authentic_task_state.description: Continuation-relevant task state required to reconstruct the next valid procedural unit.

task.description: Clear definition of the global problem context and relevant boundaries.

current_state.description: Serialized representation of the continuation-relevant current state.

local_result.description: Facts, partial results, invariants, constraints, or other results established during the current step.

structural_deadlock_object.description: Structured representation of the local boundary that prevents continuation along the current trajectory.

state.description: State at which the current trajectory reached its continuation boundary.

constraint.description: Constraint or incompatibility preventing continuation along the current trajectory.

boundary.description: Functional, mathematical, syntactical, or architectural limit reached by the current trajectory.

unresolved.description: Unresolved difference or problem dimension remaining after the current step.

swarm_delegation_metadata.description: Metadata required to construct or initialize the subsequent procedural unit through structured continuation.

unresolved_difference.description: Unresolved structural difference formatted as continuation-relevant input for the next procedural unit.

next_required_operation.description: Operation required to construct the next procedural state. This describes the required operation rather than issuing a mandatory tactical command.

c1_class_of_problem.description: Problem class for which this decomposition and delegation procedure is applicable.

c2_existence_conditions.description: Conditions under which a valid successor procedural state or solution is considered possible.

c3_completeness_check.description: Externally validated preservation of essential solution-space dimensions.

c4_compositional_integrity.description: Externally validated preservation of global compositional capability.

c5_recursion_bound.description: Runtime recursion parameters. Cross-field validation must be enforced externally.

action_on_overflow.description: Strategy mutation, alternative continuation, or safe halt to execute at the recursion limit.

semantic_beacons.description: Canonical structural identifiers used to preserve semantic continuity across changing carriers. They are identifiers, not execution commands.

mandatory_tokens.description: Array of canonical semantic anchors. Must contain both metamonism and Ex uno omnia.
